speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To begin our assessment, how many weeks pregnant are you, and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis.

The history of ice cream consumption three days prior to the onset of fever, headache, and malaise in a pregnant patient at 30 weeks gestation is highly suggestive of *Listeria monocytogenes* infection. I need to confirm if you have experienced any muscle aches, diarrhea, or changes in fetal movement, and would you be willing to undergo a blood culture?
